tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /theg pa chen po blo sbyong don bdun gyi

khrid y-ig bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir dpal ldan a ti sha'i bka' brgyud dri ma med pa rnams kyi thugs dam gyi mthil ni/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems lags te/ spyir rgyal ba 'brom gy-i bka' brgyud rnams la/ sngags dang cung zad 'brel ba'i gdams ngag dang*/ mdo lugs rang rkang gi gdams ngag brjod kyis mi langs ba zhig bzhugs shing*/ de thams cad kyang stong pa nyid kyi lta ba phyin ci ma log pa dang yang 'brel mod kyi/ 'on kyang lugs 'di ni kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyi bka' babs shas che bas/ bka' brgyud 'dzin pa'i skyes chen dam pa dpag tu med pa byon pa rnams kyang*/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i rnam thar kho na khul du byung ba yin/ bka' babs kyi man ngag bstan pa la phyag srol mi 'dra ba ji snyed cig bzhugs pa las/ 'di bya 'chad ka ba chen po'i bzhed pas don bdun gyi gzhung srol lags/ de la sngon 'gro rten gyi chos bstan pa dang gcig / dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems sbyang ba dang gnyis/ rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur pa dang gsum/ tshe gcig gi nyams len dril te bstan pa dang bzhi/ blo 'byongs pa'i tshad dang lnga/ blo sbyong gi dam tshig dang drug /blo sbyong gi bslab bya dang bdun no/ /dang po ni/ thog mar sngon 'gro dag la bslab/ /ces gsungs pas/ rang gi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma bsgom ste/ de nyid brgyud pa kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bsam/ mos gus dung ba dang bcas pas/ bla ma yang dag pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen pos bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba yang yang btab pas bla ma de nyid rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ snying 'od kyi gur khang sgong lkogs kha gyen bstan lta bur bzhugs par bsam la/ mos gus dung ba zhig bya/

de ni bla ma'i rnal 'byor te/ 'og gi dmigs pa gang sgom pa dang thun gyi sngon du 'di nges par bya/ sngon 'gro'i dmigs pa dngos ni/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ las rgyu 'bras bsam pa rnams lags pas/ 'khrid gsar pa yin na/ bstan rim bzhin du dmigs pa'i rnam grangs shin tu mang pa dang bcas/ zhib mor dpyad nas rgyud la skyes skyes su sgom du 'jug pa lags/ rjes ting nge 'dzin la rang byan chud pa lags na slar cung zad gsal 'debs kyi tshul du/ de thams cad dmigs pa gcig tu dril na/ yang yang mi rnyed pa'i mi lus khyad par can da res rnyed pa las/ ci nas kyang chos nyams su len dgos pa 'dug /de yang nam 'chi cha med pas da lta nyid du chos rang byed/ 'chi ba'i tshe zas nor longs spyod dgra gnyen gnas lus dbang thang sogs gang yang rjes su mi 'brang*/ phan gnod spu tsam yang med/ tshe 'di ltas kyi dngos po thams cad gang legs byung legs la thong cis kyang dgos pa med/ dge sdig gnyis po ni nges par rjes su 'brang*/ sdig pa byas zin pa skyur dbang ni med/ dge ba rang gis ma byas pa khyer rgyu ni med/ las kyi dbang gis 'gro ba rigs drug gang du skyes kyang*/ sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig ma gtogs pa skyed med/ ngan song gsum du skyes na ci tsug byed/ mi skye ba'i gdeng ni gcig kyang med/ da yongs sdig pa srog la bab kyang mi byed/ dge ba la nan tan du bsgrub snyam pa la yang yang sbyong ba yin/ thun mjug tu yan lag bdun pa ci 'grub bya/ thun mtshams su dmigs pa'i don lag len la gdab pa'o/ /gong 'og thams cad du 'di nyid lag len la theb pa gal che'o// //gnyis pa dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyang ba la/ zhar byung don dam byang sems sgom pa dang*/ gtso bo kun rdzob byang sems bsgom pa gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ chos kun rmi lam lta bur bsam/

/ma skyes rig pa'i gshis la dpyad/ /gnyen po nyid kyang rang sar grol/ /ngo bo kun gzhi'i ngang la bzhag /ces gsungs pa'i gnad kyi dril don ni/ sngon 'gro dang rjes sngar ltar las/ dngos gzhi dmigs pa ni phyi nang du snang ba'i dngos po 'di dag thams cad/ snang ba ltar bden bden 'dra bar 'dug kyang rang gi sems kyi 'khrul snang yin/ don la cung zad kyang grub pa med pas rmi lam dang 'dra zhes 'dun pa cung zad sbyangs la/ slar rang sems kyi ngo bo la cer gyis bltas shing*/ btsal ba na kha dog dbyibs sogs ngo bo gang du'ang ma grub pa la/ sems kyang skye med bden med du thag bcad nas/ snying po bden med kyi 'dun pa kho rang gi ngo bo la bltas pas gtad med du yal ba de ka'i ngang du lhod kyis slod la bzhag go /de nyid yang dang yang du bsgom par bya zhing*/ thun mtshams sgyu ma'i skyes bur bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ thun mtshams spyod lam ci byed kyang*/ snang ba ci shar de la sgyu ma lta bu med bzhin du snang bar thag bcad pa'i 'dun pa rgyun chags su bskyang ngo*/ /gnyis pa kun rdzob byang sems la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ byams snying rje sgom pa yin te/ de la dang po skye bla ba la sgom pa ni/ drin che zhing nye ba'i pha ma mdza' bshes sogs dang*/ sdug bsngal che ba ngan song gsum dang*/ gzhan yang sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba'i mi la sogs pa dang*/ sdig pa che ba tshe 'dir dpal 'byor dbang thang sogs yod srid kyang*/ sdig pa rngam po byas pas shi ma thag dmyal bar skye nges rnams la thog mar bsgom/ de nas skye dka' ba gnod byed dgra dang gdon rnams la bsgom/ de nas sems can thams cad la bsgom/ de yang dang por rang gi tshe 'di dang dngos kyi mas ji ltar phan gdags pa bsam/ de bzhin du sems can thams cad pha mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med pas/ de thams cad kyang de ltar phan 'dogs pa sha stag yin/

de yang skye ba gcig kho na ma yin gyi/ skye ba grangs med pa'i pha ma 'ba' zhig yin pas/ 'di rnams bde ba dang skyid pa zhig bya dgos/ da lta mi 'dod bzhin du sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong bar ma zad/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu rngam po che la 'jug pa 'di rnams snying re rje/ bdag gi pha ma sdug bsngal myong ba 'di kun ci tsug rang bya/ zhes sems can sdug bsngal myong ba la mi bzod pa'i sems gang drag ci drag gi tshul du bya'o// //gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ gtong len gnyis po spel mar sbyangs/ /de nyid rlung la skyon te bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ snga ma bzhin du byams pa dang snying rje bsgom ste/ snying rje'o zer nas bzhag pas mi phan/ 'di dag gi sdig pa dang sdug bsngal bdag gis blangs/ bdag gi bde ba dang dge ba 'di rnams la sbyin snyam pa byas la/ dbugs nang du rngub pa dang bstun nas/ de thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sdug bsngal bdag la smin/ dbugs phyir 'gro ba dang bstun nas bdag gi bde dge ci yod pa sems can thams cad la re re byung bar bsam/ de ltar byung ba la dga' ba yang bsgom ste dmigs skor gcig /yang snga ma bzhin nas rlung nang du rngub pa dang bstun/ de thams cad kyi sdig sdug thams cad ko ba skyi gris bzhar ba bzhin du nag 'ub kyis byung sna sgo nas zhugs te rang gi snying gar/ thim dbugs phyir 'gro ba na/ rang gi bde ba dang dge ba thams cad zla ba lta bu'i rnam pas sna sgo nas dkar lam gyis song*/ sems can thams cad la phog de rnams de nyid du sangs rgyas thob par bsam/ de la dga' ba yang bsgom/ de ltar dbugs phyir 'gro nang 'gro thams cad la sbyang bar bya'o// //gsum pa rjes thun mtshams kyi nyams len la/ yul gsum dus gsum dge rtsa gsum/ /spyod lam kun tu tshig gis sbyangs/ /len pa'i thog ma rang nas brtsams/ /zhes gsungs pas/ yul dga' ba dang yid du 'ong ba la zhen chags/

gnod pa byed pa dang yid du mi 'ong ba la sdang sems/ bar ma la ci yang mi gsal ba'i rmongs ba'i sems rnams 'byung bas/ de dag nam byung tsa na sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa dug gsum thams cad/ bdag gi 'di la 'dus par gyur cig /de rnams nyon mongs pa dang bral bar gyur cig /de rnams kyi nyon mongs kyi gob bdag gi 'dis chod par gyur cig snyam du bsam pas/ dug gsum dge rtsar 'gyur ba'o// dus thams cad du/ bdag la de dag sdig smin zhing*/ /bdag dge ma lus der smin shog /ces pa dang*/ khe dang rgyal kha thams cad jo bo sems can pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /gyong dang bub kha thams cad bdag gis blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes yang yang brjod cing yid la bsam/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal len pa'i sngon du/ rang la skye ba gzhan du 'byung 'gyur gyi sdug bsngal thams cad da lta smin par bsam mo// //gsum pa rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba ni/ snod bcud sdig pas gang ba'i tshe/ /rkyen ngan byang chub lam du bsgyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rkyen ngan thog tu bab pa'i tshe/ byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur dgos pa yin pas/ de yang da lta nas sbyangs dgos te/ de la gsum/ kun rdzob byang sems la brten pa dang*/ don dam byang sems la brten pa dang*/ sbyong ba khyad par can la brten pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ le lan thams cad gcig la gda'/ /kun la bka' drin che bar sgoms/ /zhes pas rang la gzhan gyis gnod pa byed pa dang*/ lus la na tsha sems la sdug bsngal/ rang phyogs gyi sde grong zhig nyams/ grogs kyis bslus pa mi 'dod pa ci byung na yang/ 'di ltar gnod pa byas snyam pa'i 'khon 'dzin dang*/ gzhan la 'dis lan zhes mi bsam par/ rang la bsam ste bdag gces 'dzin 'dis las ngan bsags pas lan pa yin/ rang sdug rang gis nyos pa yin/ da bdag gces 'dzin 'di ci rlag la gtong*/ gnod byed 'di rnams bdag gi sdig sgrib sbyong mkhan yin pas shin tu bka' drin che snyam du yang yang bsgom/

gnyis pa ni/ 'khrul snang sku bzhir lta ba yin/ /stong nyid bsrung ba bla na med/ /ces te/ spyir snang ba thams cad dang dgos rkyen ngan ci byung ba de la/ 'di snang yang bden par grub pa cung zad kyang med snyam pa/ skye 'gag gnas gsum gang la brtags kyang*/ ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba'i rang bzhin du shes nas/ snang tsam de la ci yang ma yin pa'i mi rtog par bzhag /de yang stong pa chos sku/ gsal ba sprul sku/ zung 'jug longs sku/ dbyer med ngo bo nyid kyi sku'o/ / gsum pa ni/ sbyor ba bzhi ldan thabs kyi mchog /'phral la gang thug sgom du sbyar/ /zhes gsungs te/ de la sbyor ba bzhi ldan ni/ tshogs bsags pa'i sbyor ba/ sdig pa bshags pa'i sbyor pa/ lha 'dre la gtor ma sbyin pa/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong la mchod gtor 'bul ba'o/ /de yang 'di ltar bsgom ste/ bdag sdug bsngal mi 'dod cing bde ba 'dod na/ de phyin ci log tu 'ong ba 'di tshogs bsogs shig /sdig pa sbyongs shig ces pa'i brdar 'dug pas da de ltar bya dgos snyam nas/ yan lag bdun pa dang khyad par dkon mchog gsum la mchod bstod rgya cher bya/ sdig pa bshags bsdams drag tu bya/ thun mtshams thams cad du zang zing yo byad bla ma dang dge 'dun la 'bul ba/ sku gzugs lha khang glegs bam la sogs pa bzhengs pa dge ba'i rkyen 'ba' zhig tu 'gro bar bya/ sdig bshags kyi don du mdo 'don pa gzungs bzla ba sāts+tsha gdab pa/ phyag dang bskor ba sogs la 'bad/ gnod byed rnams la dmigs nas gtor ma sbyin te/ khyed kyis sngar bdag gi lan chags 'jal du 'ongs/ bu lon khyer bar byed pa shin tu bka' drin che/ da dung bdag brlag par mdzad du gsol/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa/ nad byur chags nyam nga thams cad nga la spung du gsol/ sems can rnams sdug bsngal dang bral bar mdzod cig ces bya/ chos skyong la mchod gtor phul nas kyang tshe 'di'i bde skyid la gsol ba mi 'debs/

bdag na ba legs na na bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ shi ba legs na shi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sos pa legs na sos par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes sogs re dogs 'gog pa'i gsol 'debs bya'o/ /'phral du bya ba ci byed kyang thams cad sems can la phan pa'i don du byed snyam pa dang*/ dge ba la sogs pa'i rang gi bya ba legs pa kun la sems can thams cad 'di bas kyang ches lhag pa'i chos kyi bya ba la 'jug par gyur cig snyam pa dang*/ gal te bya ba ngan pa la dbang med 'jug dgos byung ba'am rnam rtog ngan pa byung na/ sems can thams cad kyi bya ba dang sems ngan pa thams cad bdag gi 'di la 'dus par gyur cig snyam pa bsam pa thag pa nas bya/ za nyal 'chag pa sogs btang snyoms kyi bya ba thams cad kyang*/ gzhan don gyi sems nyag gcig gis bya'o// //bzhi pa tshe gcig gi nyams len dril te bstan pa la/ man ngag snying po mdor bsdus pas/ /stobs lnga dag dang sbyar bar bya/ /theg chen 'pho ba'i gdams ngag ni/ /stobs lnga 'di yin spyod lam gces/ /zhes gsungs te/ de la stobs lnga ni/ 'phen pa'i stobs/ goms pa'i stobs/ dkar po'i sa bon gyi stobs/ sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ smon lam gyi stobs rnams yin te/ de yang 'phen pa/ dus 'di nas bzung ste sangs rgyas pa thob bar dang*/ khyad par ma shi ba'i bar du dang*/ yang dgos de ring lta bu cig la byang chub kyi sems dang gtan nas ma bral bar bya zhes drag tu bsam/ goms pa ni byang chub kyi sems gnyis drag tu sbyong ba'o/ /dkar po'i sa bon ni/ lus ngag yid gsum dge sbyor dang dge ba'i las la chog tshod mi byed par ci 'grub 'grub sgrub pa'o// sun 'byin pa ni/ da yang bdag 'dzin 'di cis kyang thul ba zhig bya/ sngar yang 'khor bar 'khyams shing sdug bsngal myong ba 'di kho nas lan/ da yang 'di dang 'grogs na skyid med/ da res 'di ci brlag cig bya snyam du 'dun pa yang yang gtong pa'o/

/smon lam ni/ spy-ir sems can thams cad 'khor ba nas 'dren pa dang*/ dgos su byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa'i rgyur dge ba thams cad bsngo zhing smon lam 'debs pa'o/ /'pho ba ni/ dang por yo byad thams cad zhen chags med par/ rang phan yon 'di rang che snyam pa'i yid ches yod pa'i sar dge ba gtong pa/ dkar po'i sa bon gyi stobs dang*/ de skye ba thams cad du byang chub kyi sems sgom pa'i rgyur smon lam 'debs pa smon lam gyi stobs dang*/ sun 'byin pa'i stobs gong bzhin gsal btab/ 'chi kha bar do skye ba thams cad du byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang ma bral ba byed snyam pa 'phen pa'i stobs dang*/ spyod lam lus gnad chos bdun nam/ de ma nus na glo g.yas phab/ sna bug g.yas bkag la/ sngon sgom pa'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyong ba ni goms pa'i stobs so/ /'dir 'gron bu ma nyams pa mes bsregs pa'i thal pa dang*/ rdo khab len gyi phye ma sbrang smyon la sbyar ba spyi bor byugs pa rdzas kyi 'pho ba'i man ngag yin no// //lnga pa blo 'byongs pa'i tshad ni/ chos kun dgongs pa gcig tu 'dus/ / zhes chos thams cad kyi dgongs pa bdag 'dzin 'dul bar 'dus pas blo sbyong sgom bzhin bdag gces 'dzin je chung du 'gro ba dgos/ dbang po gnyis kyi gtso bo bzung zhes rang blo drang po zhig gis rang la ma khrel ba cig dgos/ yid bde 'ba' zhig rgyun du bsten/ zhes rkyen ngan sdug bsngal ci byung yang*/ de la 'jigs skrag dang yi mug ni nam yang mi skye bar/ dge sbyor gyi grogs su 'gro bas/ mi 'dod pa byung ba sogs kyis yid mi bde ba med pa'o/ /yengs kyang thub na 'byongs pa yin/ /zhes ched gtad gnyen pos ma btul/ dran pas ma bzung na yang dgra gnyen bde sdug gnod byed thams cad kyi steng du/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis rtsol med du lhan lhan skye'o/ /bzhi po 'di dag n-i blo sbyong gnad du song ba'i tshad de/

'di rnams yod kyang phyis sgom mi dgos pa ni ma yin no// //drug pa blo sbyong gi dam tshig la/ spyi don gsum la rtag tu bslab// ces pa ni/ blo sbyong khas blang dang ma 'gal ba ste/ sdom gsum nyes ltung gi dri mas ma gos pa dang*/ tho cor ma shor ba ste/ rang la bdag gces 'dzin med par gzhan gyis dkor re ba'i shing gnyan gcod pa/ chu mig dkrugs pa/ lha rten sgyel ba/ mdze sprang dang 'grogs pa sogs spangs te/ rnam thar gtsang bar byed pa dang phyogs rer ma song ba ste/ dgra gnyen phyogs re la blo sbyong ba'am/ gdon gyi gnod pa bzod la da lta'i gnod pa mi bzod pa dang*/ dgra gnyen bzod kyang sdug bsngal mi bzod pa dang*/ de kun bzod kyang skyid thog tu chos 'chor ba sogs phyogs re ba ma yin par/ bde sdug rkyen bzang ngan sogs thams cad la sbyong ba'o/ /'dun pa bsgyur la rang sar bzhag /ces sngar rang gces gzhan mi gces pa'i 'dun pa de bsgyur la rang thed la 'bor te/ de yang*/ mngon tshan med par rang sor 'jog /yan lag nyams pa brjod mi bya/ /zhes gzhan gyi skyon mi brjod/ /gzhan phyogs gang yang mi bsam mo/ / zhes gzhan su la'ang skyon zhig 'dug pa mthong na/ nga rang snang ba ma dag pa yin khong la de lta bu e yod mi shes rang snang ma dag pas/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyang skyon can zhig tu lta ba ji snyed cig byung ba dang 'dra snyam/ rang sems skyon can tshar bcad par bya'o/ /nyon mongs gang che sngon la sbyangs/ /zhes rang rgyud la brtags nas nyon mongs pa gang che ba de'i steng du chos thams cad spungs dgos/ 'bras bu re ba thams cad spangs/ /zhes blo sbyong bsgoms pas lha 'dre sogs dbang du 'du la re ba'am/ rang skyes bu dam par go ba la re nas/ gnod lan du phan byed pa la sogs mgo bskor yin pas spangs/ dug can gyi zas spangs zhes pas ni/ rang gces 'dzin dang dngos po bden 'dzin gyis kun nas bslangs pa'i dge sbyor ni/

dug can yin pas 'dzin pa spangs pa'i sgyu ma lta bur shes par bya'o/ /gzhung bzang ma brten zhes pa gzhan gyis gnod pa byas pa la 'khon du 'dzin pa mi bya/ gshags ngan ma rgod ces pa ni/ gzhan skyon gyi mtshang nas mi 'bru ba'o/ /'phrang ma sgug ces pa ni gzhan gyis gnod pa byas nas lo mang po song yang ma brjed par gnod lan 'khyol dus gnod pa skyel bar mi bya/ gnad la mi dbab ces pa/ mi'i mtshang 'bru ba dang tshig rtsub byed pa dang*/ mi ma yin gyi srog sngags bzla ba sogs/ gzhan sems la zug rngu bskyed pa'i tshig mi brjod/ mdzo khal glang la mi 'byo zhes/ gzhan la khag ngan bskur ba dang*/ rang la bab pa'i dka' ba'i bya ba rnams g.yo thabs kyis gzhan la bsgyur bar mi bya/ lha bdud du mi dbab ces pa/ blo sbyong bsgoms nas rang rgyud rengs na lha bdud du babs pa dang 'dra bas/ chos tsi tsam sgom gyin rang rgyud je thul du 'gro bar bya'o/ /lto log mi bya zhes pa/ nad zhi ba gdon zhi ba rkyen ngan bzlog la re nas blo sbyong byed na/ gto bcos bon gyer dang 'dra bas snyems 'khrigs re dogs spangs te bsgom/ skyid kyi yan lag tu sdug ma tshol zhes pa ni/ yon bdag la na tsha shi chad byung na tshogs gsog yong*/ grwa rogs grogs mched shi na dpe cha lha rten sogs 'ong*/ /rang dang mnyam pa shi na nga gcig pu la bsod nams 'ong*/ dgra shi na 'tsheng snyam pa dang*/ mdor na rang skyid pa'i phyir du gzhan la sdug bsngal dang mi 'dod pa yong du re ba de spong ba'o// //bdun pa blo sbyong gi bslab bya ni/ rnal 'byor thams cad gcig gis bya/ /zhes zas kyi rnal 'byor/ gos kyi rnal 'byor/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ 'dug pa'i rnal 'byor sogs thams cad gzhan la phan pa'i sems 'ba' zhig gis bya'o/ /log gnon thams cad gcig gis bya/ /zhes nyams len byas dus nad mang ba dang*/ gnod pa kha zug pa dang*/ mi kha sdang ba dang*/

sgom gyin nyon mongs che ru 'gro ba 'dra ba byung na sgom log yin te/ de thams cad la log gnon ni/ mi 'dod pa 'di'i steng du sems can thams cad kyi mi 'dod pa sdug bsngal thams cad 'dus par gyur cig snyam du/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i log gnon kho na bya'o/ /thog mtha' gnyis la bya ba gnyis/ /zhes snga dro de ring nyes ltung gi dri mas ma gos pa bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa shugs drag sbyangs/ srod la de'i nyin gos ma gos bltas te/ nyes ltung ma byung na dga' ba bsgom/ byung na bshags bsdams bya/ nyin bar yang dran gsos yang yang bya'o/ /gnyis po gang byung bzod par bya/ /zhes sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa nyams dma' ba gang byung na'ang*/ sngon gyi las kyi mthur bsam ste zhe 'khang dang sems sdug mi bya/ gzhan gyi sdig sdug thams cad blangs/ sdig sgrib sbyang ba'i thabs la 'bad par bya ste/ sdug bsngal bzod pa dang*/ bde skyid 'byor ba'i tshe/ bag med dang btang snyoms mi bya bar nor dge phyogs su btang*/ dbang thang dge bar bsgyur/ sems can thams cad bde skyid dang ldan par smon lam btab pas skyid pa bzod par bya'o/ /gnyis po srog dang bsdos nas bsrung*/ zhes chos spyi'i bslab bya thams cad dang*/ blo sbyongs dgos kyi bslab bya/ ci byed rang don gyi rnam rtog gi 'khri ba ma zhugs par byed pa gnyis las ma 'das par bsrung ba'o/ / dka' ba gsum la bslab par bya/ /zhes nyon mongs dang por ngo shes dka' bas/ skyes ma thag nyon mongs yin par shes par bya/ bar du bzlog dka' bas/ de ma thag 'phral du spong*/ mthar rgyun gcod dka' ba la/ phyin chad 'di lta bu gtan nas mi 'byung ba bya snyam pa'i zhe bcad dam po bya'o/ /rgyu'i gtso bo rnam gsum blangs/ /zhes bla ma dam pa dang mjal ba/ rang rgyud las su rung ba/ zas gos mthun rkyen 'dzom pa ste/ dge sbyor skye ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo gsum po de rang la tshang na/
sems can thams cad kyang de dang ldan par smon lam btab/ ma tshang na gang ma tshang ba de nyid kyi steng du/ sems can thams cad kya

ི de gsum ma tshang ba thams cad spungs nas/ de rnams de gsum dang ldan par gyur cig ces smon lam btab/ nyams pa med pa rnam gsum sgoms/ zhes bla ma la mos gus nyams pa med pa/ blo sbyong sgom pa la spro ba nyams pa med pa/ sdom pa gsum gyi bslab bya nyams pa med pa rnams la slob/ 'bral med gsum dang ldan par bya/ /zhes lus ngag yid gsum dus rtag tu dge ba dang ma bral bar bya/ yul la phyogs med dag tu sbyangs/ khyab dang gting 'byongs kun la gces/ zhes yul sems can rnams dang 'byung ba bzhi sogs bzang ngan thams cad la blos khyab par bya zhing*/ de yang kha tsam tshig tsam min par blos gting nas 'byongs par bya'o/ /bkol pa rnams la rtag tu bsgom/ /zhes blo sbyong dka' ba'i yul ni sdang ba'i dgra/ gnod pa'i bgegs/ khyad par rang gis phan btags pa'i lan du gnod pa byed pa'i log sgrub mkhan rnams la gtso bor blo sbyong bar bya'o/ /rkyen gzhan gang la'ang ltos mi bya/ /zhes khams bzang ngan dang*/ longs spyod dkon mod dang*/ mi kha byams mi byams sogs gang la'ang khyad med par blo sbyong ba ste/ gzhan la rag ma las pa'o/ /da res gtso bo nyams su blangs/ /zhes da res tshe 'di las phyi ma'i don gtso che de yang 'khor ba las thar ba gtso che/ rang don pas gzhan don gtso che bshad pa bas sgrub pa gtso/ de yang mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ti'i lung rigs kyi sgo nas dpyod pa pas/ bla ma'i man ngag la phur btsugs su bsgom pa gtso/ go log mi bya zhes/ chos sgrub pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzod par/ dgra 'dul gnyen skyong ba'i bzod pa sgom pa bzod pa go log /chos rnam dag byed pa la 'dun pa mi byed par tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor la 'dun pa byed pa 'dun pa go log /thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas chos spyod kyi ro mi myong bar/ zang zing longs sbyod kyi ro myang ba ro myang go log sdig pa byed pa la snying rje mi byed par/

chos phyir dka' thub byed pa la snying rje byed pa snying rje go log /rang la ltos pa'i mi chos la mi sbyor bar/ tshe 'di'i che thabs la sbyor ba gnyer sems go log /'khor 'das kyi bde skyid dang dge ba byed pa la dga' ba mi bsgom par/ dgra la sdug bsngal byung ba la dga' ba sgom pa ni rjes su yi rang go log ste drug po de spang par bya'o/ /res 'jog mi bya/ zhes pa ni/ chos la nges shes ma skyes pas/ res byed res 'ga' mi byed pa blo sna mang pa de spangs/ dol chod du sbyang*/ zhes rnam g.yeng dang ma 'brel bar blo sbyong nyid la blo langs kyis bsgyur la phyogs gcig tu sbyong*/ rtog dpyod gnyis kyis thar bar bya/ /zhes rang rgyud la nyon mongs skye ba'i yul yid la byas te/ drag tu skye mi skye brtag skye na gnyen po drag tu bsgom/ yang bdag gces 'dzin ci 'dra 'dug blta/ gal te med pa ltar 'dug na chags sdang gi yul zhig bsam nas/ yang gces 'dzin skye bar 'dug na/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i gnyen pos de ma thag spong*/ yus ma sgom/ zhes pha rol la rang gi drin yod pa dang*/ rang gi chos nyams su blangs pa rang don yin pas/ de kun gyi yus gzhan la mi 'tshong ba'o/ /kun slong ma sdom zhes pa/ gzhan phyogs la phrag dog mi bya/ gzhan gyis rang la gnod pa'am/ dma' phab sogs byas pa la/ sems rgyud 'khrugs pas de'i lan byed pa sogs spangs/ yud tsam mi bya zhes cung zad tsam la dga' mi dga'i rnam 'gyur mi ston/ 'or che ma 'dod/ ces rang gi chos nyams su blangs pa dang*/ dge ba'i las byas pa la snyan grags yong du re ba spang ba'o/ /snyigs ma lnga po bdo ba ni/ /byang chub lam du bsgyur ba yin/ /gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i snying po 'di/ /gser gling pa nas brgyud pa yin/ /zhes kyang gsungs so/ /'di skabs su/ jo bo gser gling pa'i gsung gis/ rtog pa thams cad 'bur 'joms te/ /gnyen po thams cad bcom brdeg yin/

/ 'dun ma thams cad chig 'dril te/ /las rnams thams cad chig chod yin/ / gnyen po rnam byang gi chos bzhi ste/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin/ / 'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la/ /snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ rtog pa skyes tsam nyid nas/ stong nyid du 'bur 'joms bya/ nyon mongs skyes ma thag tu gnyen pos thog rdzis bya/ 'dun ma thams cad bdag 'dzin ci brlag dang sems la ci phan du sgril/ lam chig chod de/ sa lam rtsi rgyu med/ bdag 'dzin rnams brlag nas sangs rgyas pa yin/ rkyen ngan dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin/ /'dre gdon rgyal ba'i sprul ba yin/ /na tsha sdig sgrib kyi chags shing yin/ /sdug bsngal chos nyid kyi yo langs yin/ /kun nas nyon mongs kyi chos bzhi ste/ /mtha' 'khob sogs gong dang 'dra/ mi 'dod pa'i rkyen byung na dge bskul yong*/ gdon zhud byung na tshogs gsogs dang thugs dam 'phel/ na tsha byung na sdig sgrib 'dag /sdug bsngal rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ /chos nyid yin pas nyams su blangs chog /de kun byung na byung gi bzang*/ /zhais nyams su blangs/ skyid kyi gnya' gnon chen po yin/ /sdig gi 'jug sdud chen po yin/ /mi mkho shos la 'dod thog yin/ /ltas ngan g.yang du len pa yin/ /gnyen po log gnon gyi chos bzhi ste/ /mtha' 'khob sogs gong bzhin/ skyid skyid 'dra na/ chos min gyi bya ba sna tshogs byed 'dod nas 'ong bas/ skyid pa'i ngo bo la bltas na skyid pa dngos por grub pa med/ skyid par snang ba tsam de sems can thams cad la sbyin/ rang tsho thub par byas pas gnya' gnon yin/ cung zad gcig sdug na yi mug ga chad par 'dug /de la sdug par snang ba rmi lam sgyu ma dang 'dra/ btsal bas ma rnyed/ snang ba de'i steng du sems can thams cad kyi mi 'dod pa thams cad spungs/ sdug bya sdug byed stongs pas mjug sdud chen po yin/ ltas ngan dang cho 'phrul byung na/

rnam rtog sna tshogs 'char te/ de la 'di kha dgos rgyu yin/ bdag gces 'dzin 'di'i steng du ltas ngan thams cad spungs shig snyam pa byed cing*/ snyems 'khrigs ma zhugs par byas la bzhag /mi mkho ba thams cad thog tu bab na/ bdag gces 'dzin khyod la 'di rang 'kho ba yin/ 'di brlag tu chug cig snyam la blo bde 'bol gyis bzhag /gzhan yang 'di gcig pu 'dug na skyo rogs yin/ las ngan dbang gi sems lhongs byung*/ nang du bsdad na phyir 'gro snying 'dod/ ri la bsdad na klung la 'bab snying 'dod/ klung du phyin na ri khrod dran pa sogs 'byung ste/ sems dpa'i rim pa las/ yang yang sdod sa rang spo zhing*/ /shes pa mi dga' skyo ba na/ /rang la gshags 'debs 'di ltar bya/ khyod kyi gshis lugs 'di 'dra na/ /gnas mal 'di yang yang rab yin/ /blo sems 'di kun bde mo yin/ /gzhan du khyed kyis sdug sran 'dis/ /dmyal bar ma skyes khar rje che/ /btso bsreg ma myong khar rje che/ /zhes sogs dang*/ gzhan yang 'jigs pa rab bsams te/ /bdag la khrel brdas chen po bya/ /lto la gyong bskur dka' thub bya/ /gos la gyong bskur dman cha blangs/ /bde sdug khyad bsad gnyen po bsgom/ /na na nad g.yog yin te/ na tsha byung na nad g.yog la 'khang*/ de la 'di las drag pa zhig byed thang ba la/ 'di la nga drin che ba yin te snyam yus pa'i dus su/ na ba 'di bdag tu bzung bas lan pa yin/ gzhan sus kyang ma lan/ nad g.yog dang sman gyis phan na lta/ sngar 'di ma byas zhes bya ba med/ da yongs gces 'dzin can khyod la 'di ltar byung ba snying tshim zhes bzhag pas blo bde 'bol gyis 'gro/ bdag ni skyon gyi rtsa ba ste/ /rgyangs kyis skyur ba'i chos cig yin/ /gzhan ni yon tan gyi 'byung khungs te/ /cangs te len pa'i chos cig yin/ /gnyen po mjug sdud kyi chos gnyis te/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin/ /'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la/

/snyigs ma'i dus su dgos pa yin/ /rang skyon rgyangs kyis skyur ba dang*/ /gzhan don la cangs kyis 'jus pa gnyis su blo sbyong thams cad 'dus pa yin no// log cer log la cer cer ltos/ /shig ge shig la 'bol le zhog /des ni mi 'ching grol bar 'dod/ / rnam rtog gang shar de la sems phyir yengs su song ba 'di/ nang du log cer log /ngo bo la cer gyis ltos/ de kha'i ngo bo la shigs kyis shigs la lhod kyis bzhag /de ltar na theg pa chen po blo sbyong gi gdams ngag jo bo'i bka' brgyud yin nges khrid tshul mtha' yas pa zhig bzhugs na'ang*/ don bdun gyi gzhung shing 'dir nyams len thams cad 'du ba yin/ zhes pa 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rje btsun bla ma dam pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos de/ rje btsun dpal stag lung pa chen po dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ rje ngag dbang kun dga' legs grub bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi blo sbyong gi khrid yig bsnyel byang*/ 'dus la ma tshang pa med pa zhig yi ge'i lam du gyis shig ces bka' stsal spyi bos nod nas snying po'i don tsam bkod pa ste/ rang lo nyer drug tha skar gyi zla ba'i tshes bcu gcig la gnas mchog rnam rgyal rab brtan du'o/ /yi ge pa ni kun dga' dar rgyas so/ /bkra shis/ zhus dag / 'dir smras pa/ rje btsun mar me mdzad dpal nas brgyud pa'i/ /bdag gzhan brje ba'i blo sbyong byed pa'i thabs/ /don bdun grangs su nges pa'i man ngag 'di/ /rgya bod mkhas pa'i nyams len gnad kyi mthil/ /yongs su grags pa'i legs pa 'di dag gi /'grel pa 'jam mgon kun dga' snying po yis/ /mdzad pa'i gzhung 'di'i mi zad chos sbyin 'di/ /tshul khrims bzang pos bskrun pa'i dge ba yis/ /ma rgan 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi/ /rgyud la byang chub sems mchog skyes gyur cig /puṇ+ye shrīs bris pa'o//
